Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: round full face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: sharply stepped fringe. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a shallow cheek scar. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
